title: 第十章 三十六条经脉图
content_zh:
张若尘思索了片刻，又问道： “林辰裕被处死了？”
“没有！七王子殿下哪那么容易放过他？”云儿道： “林辰裕被处以宫刑，变成了一个太监，被七王子殿下收为奴仆。”
张若尘道： “林家的第一天才，却变成了太监，还成为敌人的奴仆。对林家来说，简直就是一个巨大的耻辱。”
云儿皱着眉头，道： “可是我十分不能理解，既然林家受了如此大的屈辱。为何林家的家主还要将自己的女儿，嫁给七王子？”
张若尘道： “这很好理解！以七王子的天资，将来必定会继承王位，成为云武郡国之主。林家想要在云武郡国立足，就肯定要和七王子修复关系。联姻是最好的办法。”
“其次，林家的第一天才，既然成为七王子的奴仆。林家和七王子的关系，估计没有我们想象中那么敌对。说不定，林泞姗和七王子的联姻，就是林家的第一天才林辰裕一手促成。”
云儿的眼睛笔直的盯着张若尘，简直无法相信，九王子殿下竟然能够分析的如此头头是道，根本不像是曾经的那一个怯弱的少年，反而给人一种老练、睿智的感觉。
“看来开启神武印记之后，真的让九王子殿下彻底发生了改变。”云儿的心头暗想，若是林妃娘娘知道九王子殿下发生了这么大的改变，肯定会十分欣慰。
回到自己的房间，张若尘立即进入时空晶石的内空间。
“现在就开始开辟第二条经脉！”
张若尘将小玉瓶的瓶塞
在洗髓液的药力作用下，全身血液都像是沸腾起来。借助庞大的药力，张若尘立即按照《九天明帝经》上面的记载，开始开辟第二条经脉。
体内开辟出来的经脉越多，吸收灵气的速度就越快，体内真气的运行速度也越快。
体内的经脉越多，修炼出来的武体自然也就更加强大，在同境界，可以爆发出更加强大的战力。
借助曾经的修炼经验，张若尘很快就开辟出第二条经脉，体内真气的运行速度提升了一倍。
“气池并没有扩大，没有突破黄极境中期，看来还要再开辟出一条经脉才行。”
张若尘服下一枚血丹，恢复体力，大概休息了一个时辰，使自己达到最佳状态之后，便立即又服下一份洗髓液，开始开辟第三条经脉。
别的那些修士，开辟出一条新的经脉之后，一般都要调养一个月到三个月，增加经脉的韧性和活性，才会继续开辟下一条经脉。
可是张若尘却等不到一个月之后，他现在就要开辟第三条经脉，冲击黄极境中期。
这样一来，难度何止增加了一倍。

“我一定能行，一定可以做到，今晚一定要冲击到黄极境中期。”
张若尘的手中捏着一枚灵晶，一边吸收灵晶中的灵气，一边调动体内的全部真气，猛然的向着第三条经脉冲击过去。
“轰！”
张若尘的眉心处，发出一声闷响。
原本只有一个篮球那么大的气池，立即扩大十倍，达到一个水缸那么大，像是一个三尺见方的池子。
现在，张若尘的气池，才真正的能够称得上是气池。
这就是黄极境中期的修为！
“现在，只能算是刚刚进入黄极境中期，体内的真气并没有增加多少。当然，我现在又有提升空间了，若是我将气池中的真气修炼满，体内的真气将会增加十倍。”张若尘的心头生出一种喜悦感，武道修为终于又强大了一大截。
每提升一个境界，气池的容量就会跟着变大，自然也就能够容纳更多的真气。
若是无法突破境
界，那么就算你修炼十年，体内的真气也不会有任何增加。因为你的气池就只有那么大，只能容纳那么多真气。
突破到黄极境中期，肉身中的杂质，从毛孔中搬运出来，像是一层黑色的黏泥，发出淡淡的腥臭。
张若尘立即打来一桶热水，洗完澡之后，换上一件新的衣服，便立即回到时空晶石的内空间。
他的手中捏着一支笔，十分顺畅，在纸卷上化为一个人形的图案。
随后，他又凭借着脑海中的记忆，在人形图案上面画出三十六条经脉，每一条经脉的运行路线都各不相同。
只有一个共同点：三十六条经脉，全部都要汇聚到眉心的气池。
张若尘第一次翻阅《九天明帝经》的第一层，看到的就是这样一张 “经脉图”，没有任何文字解释，完全靠自己去参悟。
修炼的功法越高级，在体内开辟出来的经脉就越多，真气的搬运速度就越快。
“人级下品的功法，只能开辟出七条经脉。”
“《九天明帝经》上面却记载有三十六条经脉的运行路线，每增加一条修炼经脉，武体就强大一分。若是将三十六条经脉全部开辟出来，武体将会变得何等强大？”

黄极境的 “极”字，代表的就是经脉的极限的意思。
张若尘上一世也仅仅只是修炼出三十三条经脉，还有三条经脉，怎么都开辟不出来！
以他上一世的开辟出三十三条经脉的武体，便已经打败同辈无敌手。即便当今天下第一强者池瑶女皇都比他差了一筹，只开辟出三十一条经脉。
“我现在已经开辟出三条经脉，属于黄极境中期，想要突破到黄极境后期，至少要再开辟出三条经脉才行。”
张若尘将经脉图卷起来，放在石台上。
想要冲击黄极境后期，就必须先要将气池中的真气修炼满。..
若是循规蹈矩的修炼，就算借助灵晶的灵气，也需要修炼一个半月的时间才能让真气充盈全身，溢满气池。
张若尘等不了那么久，所以，他决定服用 “聚气丹”。
一枚聚气丹价值一千银币，对于一般的武者来说，简直就是不可多得的宝物。即便是那些中等家族的年轻子弟，也很难得到一枚聚气丹。
张若尘一次性购买了十枚，就是打算用来快速提升自己的修为。
聚气丹，只有一粒珍珠大小，带着淡淡的清香，用肉眼都能看见一缕缕灵气在丹药的表面流动。
张若尘将聚气丹吞进嘴里。
片刻之后。
“轰”的一声，聚气丹在体内炸开，化为一团狂暴的丹气，在张若尘的体内上串下跳。
三条经脉以最快的速度吸收丹气，在体内运行一个大周天，丹气便转化为真气，储存在气池。
虽然，张若尘已经尽最大努力吸收丹气，可是依旧有七成丹气从毛孔中流失。他仅仅只是吸收了一枚聚气丹的三成丹气。
花费整整一天的时间，他才将那三成丹气完全转化为自己的真气。
炼化这三成丹气之后，气池中的真气数量，增加了两倍。
“我只开辟出了三条经脉，真气的转化速度还是太慢，七成的丹气都浪费掉了。若是一位黄极境小极位的武者，服下聚气丹，就能将聚气丹的丹气完全转化为自己的真气，不会浪费一丝。”
“不管了！只要能够快速提升修为，浪费再多银币都值得。以聚气丹的药力，我再炼化四枚，就能将气池中真气修炼满。”

幸好张若尘现在有的是银币，不用为钱财发愁。要不然的话，一千银币一枚的聚气丹，每服用一枚都会让他心疼不已。
他没有继续服用第二枚聚气丹，停止修炼，从时空晶石的内空间中走出去，重新回到房间。
他在时空晶石里面修炼了一天多时间，外面才过去半天而已。
此刻，正是中午时分。
张若尘没有惊动云儿和林妃，打来一桶热水，放在房间里面。
他不是要洗澡，而是要泡药浴。
武者，不仅仅只是要修炼真气，还有锤炼自己的身体。
张若尘的身体与同龄人相比，显得有些柔弱，想要在几个月之内让身体变得强大起来，不仅要练拳，更要泡药浴。
张若尘一共购买炼体散，每一份价值一千银币。
将其中一份炼体散取出来，放进木桶。
木桶中，立即发出 “哧哧”的声音，白色的烟雾从木桶中冒出来。
张若尘盘坐在木桶中，头顶被药水淹没。
药水十分滚烫，简直就像沸水一样，冒出一个个气泡。
一股剧痛从皮肤表面传来，随后那一股痛楚钻进血肉。最后，那一股疼痛感进入骨髓。
全身上下，火辣辣的疼痛。若是别的武者，肯定忍受不了这一股疼痛，会从木桶中跳出去。
张若尘简直就像是磐石一样，盘坐在木桶的底部，没有任何表情变化，默默的忍受那一股来自肉身的疼痛。
只有吃得苦中苦，才能成为人上人。
content_en:
Zhang Ruochen thought for a moment and then asked, "Lin Chenyu was executed?"
"No! How could His Highness the Seventh Prince let him go so easily?" Yun'er said: "Lin Chenyu was sentenced to castration and turned into a eunuch, and was taken in as a slave by His Highness the Seventh Prince."
Zhang Ruochen said: "The number one genius of the Lin family has become a eunuch and a slave of the enemy. For the Lin family, it is simply a huge shame."
Yun'er frowned and said, "But I can't understand it. Since the Lin family has suffered so much humiliation, why does the head of the Lin family want to marry his daughter to the seventh prince?"
Zhang Ruochen said: "This is easy to understand! With the seventh prince's talent, he will definitely inherit the throne and become the master of Yunwu County in the future. If the Lin family wants to gain a foothold in Yunwu County, they must repair their relationship with the seventh prince. Marriage is the best way."
"Secondly, since the number one genius of the Lin family has become the slave of the seventh prince, the relationship between the Lin family and the seventh prince is probably not as hostile as we imagined. Maybe the marriage between Lin Nianshan and the seventh prince was facilitated by the number one genius of the Lin family, Lin Chenyu."
Yun'er's eyes were staring straight at Zhang Ruochen. She couldn't believe that His Highness the Ninth Prince was able to analyze so clearly. He didn't look like the timid young man he once was. Instead, he gave people a sophisticated and wise feeling.
"It seems that after activating the mark of Shenwu, His Highness the Ninth Prince has really changed completely." Yun'er thought to himself, if Concubine Lin knew that His Highness the Ninth Prince had undergone such a big change, she would definitely be very pleased.
Returning to his room, Zhang Ruochen immediately entered the inner space of the space-time crystal.
"Start opening the second meridian now!"
Zhang Ruochen removed the stopper of the small jade bottle
Under the influence of the medicine of the marrow cleansing liquid, the blood all over the body seemed to be boiling. With the help of the huge medicinal power, Zhang Ruochen immediately started to open the second meridian according to the records in the "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra".
The more meridians opened up in the body, the faster it absorbs spiritual energy, and the faster the true energy moves in the body.
The more meridians in the body, the more powerful the martial body will be. In the same realm, it can explode with more powerful combat power.
With the help of his previous training experience, Zhang Ruochen quickly opened up a second meridian, doubling the speed of the true energy in his body.
"The Qi pool has not expanded, and it has not broken through to the middle stage of Huangji Realm. It seems that another meridian will be opened up."
Zhang Ruochen took a blood pill to regain his strength. After resting for about an hour to reach his best condition, he immediately took another marrow cleansing liquid and started to open the third meridian.
Other monks, after opening a new meridian, usually need to recuperate for one to three months to increase the toughness and activity of the meridian before continuing to open the next meridian.
But Zhang Ruochen could not wait until a month later. He was about to open a third meridian and reach the middle stage of Huangji Realm.
In this way, the difficulty is more than doubled.
"I can definitely do it, I can definitely do it, and I will definitely hit the middle stage of Huangji Realm tonight."
Zhang Ruochen held a spiritual crystal in his hand. While absorbing the spiritual energy in the spiritual crystal, he mobilized all the energy in his body and suddenly struck towards the third meridian.
"Boom!"
There was a muffled sound between Zhang Ruochen's eyebrows.
The qi pool that was originally only the size of a basketball immediately expanded tenfold, reaching the size of a water tank, like a three-foot-square pool.
Now, Zhang Ruochen's Qi pool can truly be called a Qi pool.
This is the cultivation level in the middle stage of Huangji Realm!
"Now, it can only be said that I have just entered the middle stage of Huangji Realm, and the zhenqi in my body has not increased much. Of course, I now have room for improvement. If I practice the zhenqi in the qi pool to full, the zhenqi in my body will increase tenfold." Zhang Ruochen felt a sense of joy in his heart.His martial arts cultivation finally became much stronger.
Every time you advance to a higher level, the capacity of the qi pool will increase accordingly, and it will naturally be able to accommodate more true qi.
If you can't break through
Realm, then even if you practice for ten years, the true energy in your body will not increase at all. Because your Qi pool is only so big and can only hold so much Qi.
After breaking through to the middle stage of Huangji Realm, the impurities in the body are transported out of the pores, like a layer of black slime, emitting a faint fishy smell.
Zhang Ruochen immediately brought a bucket of hot water. After taking a bath, he put on a new piece of clothes and immediately returned to the inner space of the space-time crystal.
He held a pen in his hand, which turned into a human-shaped pattern on the paper roll smoothly.
Then, relying on the memory in his mind, he drew thirty-six meridians on the humanoid pattern, each with a different route.
There is only one thing in common: the thirty-six meridians all converge into the Qi pool between the eyebrows.
Zhang Ruochen flipped through the first layer of the "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra" for the first time, and what he saw was such a "meridian diagram" without any written explanation, and he had to completely understand it by himself.
The more advanced the skills you practice, the more meridians are opened up in the body, and the faster the true energy is transported.
"The low-level human-level skills can only open up seven meridians."
"The "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra" records the running routes of thirty-six meridians. Every time a meridians are added, the martial body becomes stronger. If all thirty-six meridians are opened up, how powerful will the martial body become?"
The word "ji" in the Huangji realm represents the limit of the meridians.
Zhang Ruochen only cultivated thirty-three meridians in his previous life, and there were three more meridians that he couldn't open up no matter what!
With his martial body that opened up thirty-three meridians in his previous life, he had already defeated the invincible opponents of his generation. Even Queen Chi Yao, the most powerful person in the world today, is a step behind him, having only developed thirty-one meridians.
"I have now opened three meridians, which belong to the middle stage of Huangji Realm. If I want to break through to the late Huangji Realm, I need to open up at least three more meridians."
Zhang Ruochen rolled up the meridian diagram and placed it on the stone platform.
If you want to reach the later stage of Huangji Realm, you must first cultivate the full amount of Qi in the Qi pool. ..
If you practice according to the rules, even with the help of the spiritual energy of the spiritual crystal, it will take a month and a half to practice for the true energy to fill the whole body and overflow the energy pool.
Zhang Ruochen couldn't wait that long, so he decided to take the "Qi Gathering Pill".
A Qi Gathering Pill is worth a thousand silver coins, which is a rare treasure for ordinary warriors. Even those young children from mid-level families find it difficult to obtain a Qi Gathering Pill.
Zhang Ruochen bought ten of them at once, intending to use them to quickly improve his cultivation.
The Qi Gathering Pill is only the size of a pearl, with a faint fragrance. With the naked eye, you can see wisps of spiritual energy flowing on the surface of the pill.
Zhang Ruochen swallowed the Qi Gathering Pill into his mouth.
After a while.
With a "boom", the Qi Gathering Pill exploded in the body and turned into a ball of violent pill energy, jumping up and down in Zhang Ruochen's body.
The three meridians absorb the elixir energy at the fastest speed, and when it circulates in the body for a long time, the elixir energy is converted into true energy and stored in the qi pool.
Although Zhang Ruochen had tried his best to absorb the alchemy energy, 70% of the alchemy energy was still lost from his pores. He only absorbed 30% of the energy of a Qi Gathering Pill.
It took him a whole day to completely transform the 30% of the pill energy into his own true energy.
After refining 30% of the Dan Qi, the amount of True Qi in the Qi pool tripled.
"I have only opened three meridians, and the transformation speed of the true energy is still too slow, and 70% of the elixir energy is wasted. If a warrior at the lower level of Huangji Realm takes the Qi Gathering Pill, he can completely convert the elixir energy of the Qi Gathering Pill into his own innate energy.Not a penny is wasted. "
"No matter! As long as you can quickly improve your cultivation, no matter how many silver coins you waste, it's worth it. With the power of the Qi Gathering Pill, I can refine four more pills to fully cultivate the true energy in the Qi Pool. "
Fortunately, Zhang Ruochen now has many silver coins, so he doesn't have to worry about money. Otherwise, each Qi Gathering Pill costing a thousand silver coins would make him feel distressed every time he took it.
He did not continue to take the second Qi Gathering Pill, stopped practicing, walked out of the inner space of the space-time crystal, and returned to the room.
He had been practicing in the space-time crystal for more than a day, and only half a day had passed outside.
At this moment, it is noon.
Zhang Ruochen brought a bucket of hot water and placed it in the room without disturbing Yun'er and Concubine Lin.
He didn't want a bath, but a medicinal bath.
Warriors not only need to cultivate Qi, but also temper their bodies.
Compared with his peers, Zhang Ruochen's body seems a bit weak. If he wants to make his body stronger within a few months, he must not only practice boxing, but also take medicinal baths.
Zhang Ruochen purchased a total of body refining powders, each worth one thousand silver coins.
Take out one of the body refining powders and put it into the wooden barrel.
There was a "chichi" sound immediately in the barrel, and white smoke came out of the barrel.
Zhang Ruochen sat cross-legged in the wooden barrel, his head submerged in the potion.
The potion was very hot, almost like boiling water, with bubbles popping out.
A sharp pain came from the surface of the skin, and then the pain penetrated into the flesh. Finally, the pain entered the bone marrow.
There was burning pain all over my body. If it were other warriors, they would certainly not be able to bear the pain and would jump out of the barrel.
Zhang Ruochen was like a rock, sitting cross-legged at the bottom of the barrel, without any change in expression, silently enduring the pain from his body.
Only by enduring hardship can one become a master.
